name: Power Engineering
boundaries: Power Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Practical high-temperature superconducting transmission cables with zero losses at grid scale
original_dispositions.reason: Same conductor and cable concept. The gigawatt, hundreds-of-kilometers stage is later construction after a life-cycle win, and the 6–8 percent loss claim was not verified.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal grid-forming control architecture for 100 percent inverter-based resources
original_dispositions.reason: The demand for one control law that is provably stable for any combination of resources is flagged there. IEEE and G-PST documents show specification and procurement still in progress.

original_dispositions.original_title: Instantaneous, non-interruptive, recoverable fault-current limiter for any voltage, with no dissipation, no voltage drop, and automatic reset
original_dispositions.reason: Resistive superconducting limiters already exist as prototypes. The demonstrated class is protection hardware on the way to higher voltage. It overlaps PWR-01’s tape and PWR-05’s protection problem. An ideal device that neither drops voltage nor dissipates energy would leave the current unchanged.

original_dispositions.original_title: Compact seasonal-scale storage above 95 percent round-trip efficiency and below $50 per kWh
original_dispositions.reason: The numerical specification was not adopted. The verified multi-day result is a prototype module, and the DOE target that was opened is 10 hours and a cost reduction, still unmet.

original_dispositions.original_title: Inherently self-healing grid with zero customer interruption for any fault or attack
original_dispositions.reason: Detecting, isolating, and reconfiguring around faults is existing protection and distribution automation. A new topological principle that guarantees zero interruption for every fault and every attack was not found in the IEEE roadmap topics or the G-PST agenda. On a converter-dominated grid, the missing physical piece is already PWR-05.

original_dispositions.original_title: Lossless bidirectional solid-state transformer above 99.5 percent efficiency at any voltage ratio, replacing utility transformers
original_dispositions.reason: The cited 1 MW live-feeder campaign was a medium-voltage power-electronics demonstration, not a new principle that replaces the transformer. The reported approximately 98 percent module peak applied to one conversion stage, and decades-long utility qualification remained open.

original_dispositions.original_title: Safe, high-power, long-distance wireless power transmission
original_dispositions.reason: The above-80-percent and gigawatt figures were not adopted. Delivery from orbit remains the further aerospace and manufacturing problem already separated under PWR-03.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect real-time blackout-prevention engine with 100 percent accuracy
original_dispositions.reason: Better prediction is an operations and data problem. A completion defined as catching every cascade is not a credible scientific test: hidden failures, protection misoperations, and weather remain contingent. Even a much better forecast would still need the energy in PWR-04 and the machine-free stability in PWR-05 before it could retire reserves and rotating plant.

original_dispositions.original_title: Materials with zero aging and infinite service life
original_dispositions.reason: A search did not find a credible program aiming at literally zero degradation for centuries. Longer design life and condition monitoring reduce replacement cost. They do not change how bulk electricity is produced, moved, or stored.

original_dispositions.original_title: Inherently stable decentralized grid with provable resilience to any disturbance and no central coordination
original_dispositions.reason: Operating one interconnection without synchronous machines would already be revolutionary. Requiring a proof against any disturbance, and requiring that proof to hold with no coordination, is a stronger control-theory claim. No interconnection-scale demonstration of that stronger claim was found, so it was not split into a second concept.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PWR-01 through PWR-05 keep their identities. No concept was deleted, replaced, or merged. No new ID was assigned.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Five concepts still meet the revolutionary-impact standard for power engineering.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PWR-01 current state now includes the 15 April 2026 Stadtwerke München–NKT letter of intent and their statement that a Munich test system had already run. The planned 15 km, 500 MW, 110 kV circuit is still a negotiation, so it does not meet the proposed service test. The unverified claim that transmission losses are 6–8 percent of all generation was left out. Resistive fault-current limiters are flagged as an overlap, not absorbed into this entry.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The planned circuit is still a negotiation, and the loss share was not verified.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PWR-02 was rechecked for a 2025–2026 utility thermophotovoltaic plant. None was identified in the sources opened. The 2024 cell result and the component-versus-plant distinction stand.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: No operating utility plant was identified in the sources opened.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PWR-03 was rechecked for a power-beaming result after the May 2025 DARPA shot. No continuous megawatt link was identified. The historical efficiency and distance figures were not adopted as the completion test. Space-based solar power stays a further breakthrough under this entry.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: No continuous megawatt link was identified in the sources opened.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PWR-04 now records the California Energy Commission / Electric Power Research Institute 2025 prototype-module result: discharge beyond 100 hours, with round-trip efficiency checked and not numerically published. The historical above-95-percent and below-$50-per-kWh figures were not adopted. Announced commercial plants were not treated as operating evidence.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Independent operating efficiency and cost for a utility plant were not established in the sources opened.

reconciliation_change_log.change: PWR-05 now records IEEE 2800.2-2026, the still-open P2800.1 grid-forming project, and the December 2025 G-PST agenda of 48 operator questions. The universal control law and the no-central-coordinator guarantee are flagged inside this entry because they are stronger versions of the same capability.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Specification and procurement remain in progress, and the stronger claims were not split into separate concepts.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Historical items on fault-current limiters, self-healing, solid-state transformers, perfect blackout prediction, and infinite-life materials were researched and not added.
